Post: ATLUTD vs Charlotte
Atlanta had taken 34 more shots than Charlotte, while generating almost the same xG: 21.67 to Charlotte's 23.32. Yet Charlotte had scored 10 more goals.
Atlanta was -6.87 goals against expected, 29th in MLS by that measure. Charlotte was essentially neutral at +0.56.

Atlanta averaged 52.6% possession, compared with Charlotte's 46.3%. Tata Martino specifically said possession and transition defense will be central tonight, noting Charlotte's four attacking players and similarities to Nashville's setup.
Atlanta possession → Atlanta territorial pressure → Charlotte looking for the moment Atlanta loses structure.

Player Impressions:  
Hoyos - a huge 2nd half performance.  stopped several goals
Báez - much better performance in both halfs.  Plus the goal
Alonso - An underwhleming performance.  Trying to organize things, but didn't control the backline
Gregersen - didn't have a great game.
Jacob - a better 2nd half.  Got much further up than in the 1st.  Often acting as the winger rather than a wingback.
Reilly - stayed on the pitch.  played much more defensive.  Still looking for more from him.
Almirón - much improved 2nd half.  Not perfect, but really good.  Plus the goal, with his right.  Trying real hard tonight.
Muyumba - very good on defense.  good tackles.  Once he has the ball, has trouble distributing
Sanchez - more control in the 2nd half.  looking good.  hoping for a bit more in distribution
Miranchuk - a better 2nd half, but not enough considering he's a DP.  Unfair, but the expectation is more than what he's providing
Picault - underwhelming from a start.  He's much better when coming on as a sub.
Brennan - didn't see much from him
Suarez-Couri - MLS debut.  By the time he came on, it was all hands on deck in defense.  He managed to clear the ball and help out.  
Gregersen - cleared the ball, did a good enough job when he came on

Tata - poor use of subs.  Didn't make any until after the 80th.  PLayers were gassed at the 60th.  Only made 3 subs.
